plan.reason: With 24 of 100 evaluations and 12 stagnated steps, increase exploration to escape the plateau while keeping current_to_best for balanced convergence. Auto surrogate adapts between RBF/quadratic as data accumulates in 10-D. Moderate population/generations keep surrogate fitting cheap per cycle; small local_fraction with radius 0.15 adds focused local search without over-exploiting a weak surrogate.

Mid-run with 44/100 evaluations, mild stagnation (7) but decent recent improvement (0.05) and high CV error (1.34) indicating surrogate uncertainty in 10-D. Raise exploration to 0.6 and radius to 0.2 to probe beyond the plateau, keeping current_to_best for stable convergence. Auto surrogate adapts between RBF and quadratic as data grows; modest local_fraction 0.3 balances local refinement. Population 36 and 6 generations fit cheaply per cycle without extra true evaluations.

Stagnation at 27 with zero recent improvement and high CV error (1.27) signals the surrogate is unreliable in 10-D and the search is plateaued. Auto surrogate lets RBF/quadratic be chosen by held-out RMSE as more points accumulate. Increase exploration to 0.85 and radius to 0.25 to reward novelty and escape the plateau, while trimming local_fraction to 0.25 so more budget goes to diverse global proposals. current_to_best keeps stable directional convergence with slightly higher mutation 0.7 for diversity. Smaller population 32 and 5 generations keep per-cycle cost low since only 36 evaluations remain.

With only 16 true evaluations left and severe stagnation (47) with zero recent improvement, the surrogate is unreliable (CV RMSE 0.74) in 10-D, so exploitation is risky. Auto surrogate adaptively picks RBF/quadratic by held-out RMSE. Switching to rand1 maximizes diversity and avoids premature convergence to a stale best; high exploration 1.2 and radius 0.3 favor novelty to probe unexplored regions, while low local_fraction 0.15 keeps sampling global. Modest mutation 0.9 and crossover 0.8 balance spread vs. stability. Small population 24 and 4 generations keep surrogate fitting cheap per cycle within the tight remaining budget.
